tables.purpose: Gate purchy records: cane quantity, yard holding, mill unloading; filtered by m_date, valid sup_mod, v_code IS NOT NULL
Center and challan performance metrics; center rows require center IS NOT NULL AND center != ''

rows.name: Operating Days
rows.description: Header box labeled Operating Days; value is dbRows array length (max 500), not distinct calendar days.
rows.source: cnt_performance (dbRows query when database tab pack loaded)

rows.name: From date
rows.description: Inclusive range start; clamped to API minDate.

rows.name: To date
rows.description: Inclusive range end; default seeded STD from dateRange.

rows.name: MTD / STD / WTD / Custom
rows.formula: STD uses season_mapping.startDate for season containing To date

rows.name: Transport Mode
rows.description: Optional; All removes filter. 99 QTROLLY and 99 QTRUCK grouped.

rows.name: Total Cane (Q)
rows.description: Gate plus center cane in range.
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; priorFlowStats from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; higher is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Total Trips
rows.description: Center trip proxy: sum center vehicle rows (not distinct challans on this card).
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; priorFlowStats from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; higher is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Avg Waiting Time (Hrs)
rows.source: cnt_performance.yard_waiting_time; gate table uses g_ctc.yard_holding_time as avgYardHrs
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; priorFlowStats from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; lower is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Yard Dev. (>8H)
rows.description: Total gate vehicles with yard hold >8h.
rows.formula: flowStats.yardDev = Total row dev on proc.yardGate = SUM(devOver8H)
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; priorFlowStats from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; lower is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Mill Dev. (>0.5H)
rows.formula: flowStats.millDev = Total row dev on proc.mill = SUM(devOver05H)
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; priorFlowStats from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; lower is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Truck Holding (H)
rows.description: Avg truck holding at centers beside Collection Centers node.

rows.name: Waiting Time (Hrs)
rows.description: Avg yard wait beside Yard node.

rows.name: Cane Holding (Hrs)
rows.description: Weighted cane holding beside Mill node.

rows.name: Total Trips
rows.description: Distinct challans in center tooltip header.

rows.name: Avg Time
rows.description: Avg center holding in tooltip header.

rows.name: Hold (H)
rows.description: Per-mode center holding in tooltip table.

rows.name: Waiting Time (Hrs)
rows.description: Large yard wait headline in tooltip.

rows.name: Dev(>8H)
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN yard_holding_time>8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

rows.name: Time at Donga (H)
rows.formula: avgDongaWait = kpis.waCane OR wAvg(gateMill,avgDongaWait); kpis: IFNULL(AVG(unloading_time),0)

rows.name: Dev(>0.5H)
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN unloading_time>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

rows.name: WA Cane Holding (kpis.caneHolding)
rows.description: Weighted avg cane holding; feeds mill floating KPI and tooltip.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(cane_holding_time*cane_qty_qtls)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cane_holding_time IS NOT NULL THEN cane_qty_qtls END),0),0)
rows.comparison: prior from API pyFrom/pyTo: same SQL packs as current (kpis, sidebar, centerSidebar, overruns, cntOverruns, procurementFlow, gateYard, gateMill). Window from resolveCockpitCompareRange. prior.kpis.caneHolding (no strip chip on floating badge).

rows.name: Yard Waiting (kpis.yardWaiting)
rows.description: AVG yard waiting from center records.
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; BiKpiCard comparisonLabel="last period"; prior.kpis.yardWaiting for strip from prior.gateYard/gateMill/kpis/procurementFlow; lower is better; hidden when priorFlowStats or delta null.

rows.name: Time at Donga (kpis.waCane)
rows.description: AVG unloading time on center records (labeled waCane in API).

rows.name: Trips (kpis.totalChallan)
rows.description: Distinct challan count in KPI pack.
rows.comparison: No comparison on procurement strip (uses centerVeh sum).

rows.name: Total Cane Purchased (Qtls)
rows.formula: SUM(purchase_qtl) FROM g_ctc WHERE m_date BETWEEN @from AND @to AND sup_mod IN ('18 QCART','36 QTROLLY','45 QTROLLY','63 QTROLLY','99 QTROLLY','99 QTRUCK') AND v_code IS NOT NULL
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; Gate1KpiCard comparisonLabel="vs last period"; higher is better; hidden when delta null.

rows.name: No. of Parchy
rows.formula: COUNT(purchyno) FROM g_ctc WHERE m_date BETWEEN @from AND @to AND sup_mod IN ('18 QCART','36 QTROLLY','45 QTROLLY','63 QTROLLY','99 QTROLLY','99 QTRUCK') AND v_code IS NOT NULL
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; Gate1KpiCard comparisonLabel="vs last period"; higher is better; hidden when delta null.

rows.name: Avg Parchy Size (Qtls)
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; Gate1KpiCard comparisonLabel="vs last period"; higher is better; hidden when delta null.

rows.name: Avg Parchy Overrun (Qtls)
rows.description: Unweighted mean of per-mode gate overrun.
rows.formula: mean(overruns.avgOverrun); per mode: AVG(purchase_qtl) - CASE WHEN sup_mod='18 QCART' THEN 18 WHEN sup_mod='36 QTROLLY' THEN 36 WHEN sup_mod='45 QTROLLY' THEN 45 WHEN sup_mod='63 QTROLLY' THEN 63 WHEN sup_mod IN ('99 QTROLLY','99 QTRUCK') THEN 99 END WHERE purchase_qtl>0 GROUP BY sup_mod
rows.comparison: pctChange(curr,prior)=((n(curr)-n(prior))/Math.abs(n(prior)))*100; null if prior=0 or non-finite. BiKpiCard: ((value-pyValue)/Math.abs(pyValue))*100; neutral |delta|<0.005; badge hidden when pyValue=0.; Gate1KpiCard comparisonLabel="vs last period"; lower is better; hidden when delta null.

rows.name: Per-mode gate overrun (API)
rows.description: overruns[] returned per sup_mod; UI shows unweighted mean only on Avg Parchy Overrun card.
rows.formula: AVG(purchase_qtl) - CASE WHEN sup_mod='18 QCART' THEN 18 WHEN sup_mod='36 QTROLLY' THEN 36 WHEN sup_mod='45 QTROLLY' THEN 45 WHEN sup_mod='63 QTROLLY' THEN 63 WHEN sup_mod IN ('99 QTROLLY','99 QTRUCK') THEN 99 END WHERE purchase_qtl>0 GROUP BY sup_mod
rows.comparison: Per-mode prior in prior.overruns but not displayed as separate cards on Gate 1.
